note: Crédit Mutuel de Maine-Anjou et Basse-Normandie's fee information document (1 January 2026): keeping an Eurocompte Confort account costs 2.15 euros a month (25.80 a year). Crédit Mutuel's regional federations each set their own prices; this is one federation's.
